entities.summary: Guillaume Du Fay was a composer and music theorist of early Renaissance music, who is variously described as French or Franco-Flemish. Considered the leading European composer of his time, his music was widely performed and reproduced. Du Fay was well-associated with composers of the Burgundian School, particularly his colleague Gilles Binchois, but was never a regular member of the Burgundian chapel himself. Guillaume Dufay was a composers & musicians from Beersel (1397-08-21, Beersel–1474-11-27). Holds notable historical significance, documented across 0 language editions of Wikipedia.
